translations.literal: In the second month of the fourth year, Liangzuo's son Bingchang sent envoys to announce the mourning, and envoys were immediately sent to offer mourning sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the fourth year, Liangzuo's son Bingchang announced the death, and the court at once sent envoys to perform mourning rites.

sentences.zh: 秉常上其父遺物。

translations.literal: Bingchang presented his father's leftover goods.
translations.idiomatic: Bingchang presented his father's remaining goods.

sentences.zh: 十月，冊秉常為夏國王。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, Bingchang was invested as King of Xia.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, Bingchang was invested as King of Xia.

sentences.zh: 十二月，來貢。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, they came to offer tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, they sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 五年七月，遣使來謝封冊，閏十一月，秉常乞賜印綬。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the fifth year, envoys were sent to thank for the investiture; in the intercalary eleventh month, Bingchang begged to be granted seals and cords.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the fifth year, they sent envoys to thank the court for the investiture; in the intercalary eleventh month, Bingchang asked for seals and cords of office.

sentences.zh: 九年，遣使來貢。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, envoys were sent to offer tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year, they sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 大康二年正月，仁懿皇后崩，遣使報哀於夏，以皇太后遺物賜之。

translations.literal: In the first month of the second year of Dakang, Empress Renyi died; envoys were sent to announce the mourning to Xia, and objects left by the Empress Dowager were bestowed.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the second year of Dakang, Empress Renyi died; the court announced the mourning to Western Xia and bestowed goods left by the Empress Dowager.

sentences.zh: 遣使來弔祭。

translations.literal: Envoys were sent to offer mourning sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: Western Xia sent envoys to perform mourning rites.

sentences.zh: 五年，來貢。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, they came to offer tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, they sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 八年二月，遣使以所獲宋將張天益來獻。

translations.literal: In the second month of the eighth year, envoys were sent presenting the Song general Zhang Tianyi whom they had captured.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the eighth year, they presented the captured Song general Zhang Tianyi.

sentences.zh: 大安元年十月，秉常遣使報其母哀。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the first year of Da'an, Bingchang sent envoys to announce his mother's mourning.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the first year of Da'an, Bingchang sent word of his mother's death.

sentences.zh: 二年十月，秉常薨，遣使詔其子乾順知國事。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the second year, Bingchang died; envoys were sent ordering his son Qianshun to administer state affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the second year, Bingchang died; the court sent envoys ordering his son Qianshun to assume provisional rule.

sentences.zh: 十二月，李乾順遣使上其父秉常遺物。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, Li Qianshun sent envoys presenting his father Bingchang's leftover goods.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, Li Qianshun sent his father's remaining goods.

sentences.zh: 四年七月，冊乾順為夏國王。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the fourth year, Qianshun was invested as King of Xia.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the fourth year, Qianshun was invested as King of Xia.

sentences.zh: 五年六月，遣使來謝封冊。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the fifth year, envoys were sent to thank for the investiture.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the fifth year, they sent envoys to thank the court for the investiture.

sentences.zh: 八年六月，夏為宋所侵，遣使乞援。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the eighth year, Xia was invaded by Song and sent envoys begging for aid.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the eighth year, Song invaded Western Xia, and Xia sent envoys pleading for aid.

sentences.zh: 壽隆三年六月，以宋人置壁壘於要地，遣使來告。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the third year of Shoulong, because Song had set up fortifications at strategic points, envoys were sent to report it.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the third year of Shoulong, Song built fortifications at key points, and Western Xia sent word.

sentences.zh: 四年六月，求援。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the fourth year, they sought aid.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the fourth year, they again asked for aid.

sentences.zh: 十一月，遣樞密直學士耶律儼使宋，諷與夏和。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, Privy Academician Yelu Yan was sent to Song to hint that they should make peace with Xia.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, Privy Academician Yelu Yan was sent to Song to urge peace with Western Xia.

sentences.zh: 夏復遣使來求援。

translations.literal: Xia again sent envoys to seek aid.
translations.idiomatic: Western Xia again sent envoys pleading for aid.

sentences.zh: 五年正月，詔乾順伐拔思母等部。

translations.literal: In the first month of the fifth year, an edict ordered Qianshun to attack the Basmyl and other tribes.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the fifth year, the court ordered Qianshun to attack the Basmyl and other tribes.

sentences.zh: 十一月，夏以宋人罷兵，遣使來謝。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, because Song had ceased hostilities, Xia sent envoys to offer thanks.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, after Song halted hostilities, Western Xia sent envoys to give thanks.

sentences.zh: 六年十一月，遣使請尚公主。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of the sixth year, envoys were sent requesting marriage to a princess.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of the sixth year, they sent envoys requesting a princess in marriage.

sentences.zh: 七年，道宗崩，遣使告哀於夏。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, Emperor Daozong died; envoys were sent to announce the mourning to Xia.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year, Emperor Daozong died, and envoys were sent to announce the mourning to Western Xia.

sentences.zh: 遣使來慰奠。

translations.literal: Envoys were sent to offer condolences.
translations.idiomatic: Western Xia sent envoys to offer condolences.

sentences.zh: 天祚即位，乾統元年，夏遣使來賀。

translations.literal: When Tianzuo succeeded, in the first year of Qiantong, Western Xia sent envoys to congratulate.
translations.idiomatic: When Tianzuo succeeded to the throne, in Qiantong 1 Western Xia sent envoys to congratulate him.

sentences.zh: 二年，復請尚公主。

translations.literal: In the second year, they again requested marriage to a princess.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, Western Xia again requested a princess in marriage.

sentences.zh: 又以為宋所侵，遣李造福、田若水來求援。

translations.literal: Again, because they had been invaded by Song, they sent Li Zaofu and Tian Ruoshui to seek aid.
translations.idiomatic: Again claiming invasion by Song, they sent Li Zaofu and Tian Ruoshui to seek Liao aid.

sentences.zh: 三年，復遣使請尚公主。

translations.literal: In the third year, they again sent envoys requesting marriage to a princess.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, they again sent envoys requesting a princess in marriage.

sentences.zh: 十月，使復來求援。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, envoys again came seeking aid.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, envoys again came seeking aid.

sentences.zh: 四年、五年，李造福等至，乞援。

translations.literal: In the fourth and fifth years, Li Zaofu and others arrived, begging for aid.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth and fifth years, Li Zaofu and others arrived pleading for aid.

sentences.zh: 以族女南仙封成安公主下嫁乾順。

translations.literal: A clanswoman, Nanxian, was enfeoffed as Princess of Cheng'an and given in marriage to Qianshun.
translations.idiomatic: A clanswoman, Nanxian, was enfeoffed as Princess of Cheng'an and given in marriage to Qianshun.

sentences.zh: 六年正月，遣牛溫舒使宋，令歸所侵夏地。

translations.literal: In the first month of the sixth year, Niu Wenshu was sent to Song with orders to return the Xia lands that had been seized.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the sixth year, Niu Wenshu was sent to Song with orders to return the seized Xia lands.

sentences.zh: 六月，遣李造福來謝。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, Li Zaofu was sent to offer thanks.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, Li Zaofu was sent to offer thanks.

sentences.zh: 八年，乾順以成安公主生子，遣使來告。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, because Qianshun's wife Princess of Cheng'an had borne a son, envoys were sent to announce it.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year, because Princess of Cheng'an had borne a son for Qianshun, envoys were sent to announce it.

sentences.zh: 九年，以宋不歸地來告。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, because Song had not returned the land, they sent word.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year, because Song had not returned the land, Western Xia sent word.

sentences.zh: 十年，遣李造福等來貢。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, Li Zaofu and others were sent with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year, Li Zaofu and others came with tribute.

sentences.zh: 天慶三年六月，來貢。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the third year of Tianqing, they came with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of Tianqing 3, they came with tribute.

sentences.zh: 保大二年，天祚播遷，乾順率兵來援，為金師所敗，乾順請臨其國。

translations.literal: In the second year of Baoda, as Tianzuo fled into exile, Qianshun led troops to assist but was defeated by Jin forces; Qianshun asked to receive him in his state.
translations.idiomatic: In Baoda 2, as Tianzuo fled into exile, Qianshun led troops to assist but was defeated by Jin forces; Qianshun asked to receive him in Xia.

sentences.zh: 六月，遣使冊乾順為夏國皇帝，而天祚被執歸金矣。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, envoys were sent to invest Qianshun as Emperor of Xia, but Tianzuo had already been captured and taken to Jin.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, envoys were sent to invest Qianshun as Emperor of Xia, but Tianzuo had already been captured and taken to Jin.

sentences.zh: 論曰：高麗、西夏之事遼，雖嘗請婚下嫁，烏足以得其固志哉？

translations.literal: Discussion: Goryeo and Western Xia served Liao; although they once requested marriage and received brides given in marriage, how could that suffice to secure their firm resolve?
translations.idiomatic: Discussion: Goryeo and Western Xia submitted to Liao; yet though marriage alliances were once sought and princesses given in marriage, how could such ties alone secure their lasting resolve?

sentences.zh: 三韓接壤，反覆易知；

translations.literal: The Three Han bordered Liao directly, and their shifts back and forth were easy to know;
translations.idiomatic: The Three Han lands lay adjacent to Liao, and their vacillations were easy to read;

sentences.zh: 涼州負遠，納叛侵疆。

translations.literal: Liang Prefecture lay far away, harboring rebels and encroaching on the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: the Liang region lay far off, sheltering rebels and encroaching on the frontier.

sentences.zh: 乘隙輒動，貢使方往，事釁隨生。

translations.literal: Seizing every opening they stirred; tribute envoys had barely set out when incidents arose.
translations.idiomatic: They stirred at every opening; no sooner had tribute envoys set out than trouble followed.

sentences.zh: 興師問罪，屢煩親征，取勝固多，敗亦貽悔。

translations.literal: Raising armies to demand accountability repeatedly troubled the emperor's personal campaigns; victories were indeed many, but defeats also left regret.
translations.idiomatic: Campaigns to punish them repeatedly drew the emperor to the field; victories were many, yet defeats left lasting regret.

sentences.zh: 昔吳趙咨對魏之言曰：「大國有征伐之兵，小國有備禦之固。」

translations.literal: Formerly Zhao Zi of Wu, replying to Wei, said: "A great state has armies for campaigns of punishment; a small state has defenses for guarding against attack."
translations.idiomatic: Long ago Zhao Zi of Wu, replying to Wei, said: "A great state has armies for punitive campaigns; a small state has defenses to hold its ground."

sentences.zh: 豈其然乎！

translations.literal: Is it not so!
translations.idiomatic: Is it not so!

sentences.zh: 先王柔遠，以德而不以力，尚矣。

translations.literal: The former kings treated the distant gently, relying on virtue rather than force—how admirable!
translations.idiomatic: The former kings treated distant peoples with gentleness, relying on virtue rather than force—how much to be admired!

sentences.zh: 遼亡，求援二國，雖能出師，豈金敵哉！

translations.literal: When Liao perished, it sought aid from the two states; though troops could be sent forth, could they match the Jin enemy!
translations.idiomatic: When Liao fell, it sought aid from these two states; though they could send troops, they were no match for the Jin!
